messages:
marta (partnerships): Heads up — Azure marketplace PO from Nimbus failed validation, procurement got a 422.
ajay (marketplace): Do we know which SKU they used? partner-managed vs our publisher SKU matters.
marta (partnerships): They're using a Nimbus SKU. PO payload they sent: 
```json
{
  "po_number": "PO-98231",
  "items": [
    {"sku": "NMB-ENTERPRISE-1", "qty": 10, "unit_price": 12000}
  ]
}
```
Marketplace error: `422 Unprocessable Entity - sku_not_found: "NMB-ENTERPRISE-1"`.
ajay (marketplace): Looks like the partner SKU isn't registered/mapped to our offer. Azure expects the alias under our publisher.
liam (finance): Procurement won't approve without a vendor alias. Our AP system requires a recognized SKU. Any quick workaround?
kelly (legal): Also saw a redline on the SOW indemnity section. Legal will not finalize until we resolve that. Procurement flagged it with the PO.
marta (partnerships): So two blockers: SKU alias and contract redline. Nimbus says they won't reissue the PO unless we accept their SKU.
ajay (marketplace): I can open a support ticket with Azure to add the alias — usual ETA ~24-48h. Faster option is to ask Nimbus to resubmit using our canonical SKU `RW-REDWOOD-PREMIUM`.
liam (finance): If they resubmit with RW-REDWOOD-PREMIUM, include a pricing reference to reconcile amounts, otherwise tax/reporting flags trigger.
kelly (legal): I can draft a compromise for the indemnity clause today to speed things, but signature still required.
deploy-bot: ticket created: #AZURE-SUPPORT-5549 — partner SKU alias request queued. ETA 36h.
ajay (marketplace): Action items: (1) legal to propose indemnity compromise (kelly), (2) marketplace to request alias (ajay), (3) finance to prepare reconciliation guidance if Nimbus resubmits (liam).
marta (partnerships): I'll tell Nimbus to standby. If Azure support doesn't confirm in 48h we'll ask Nimbus to resubmit with RW-REDWOOD-PREMIUM and include `pricing_reference: SOW-2026-05-NIMBUS` in the PO. :thumbsup:
liam (finance): Noted — include currency USD and pricing_reference to avoid reconciliation issues.
ajay (marketplace): I'll update the partner runbook with the flow and link the support ticket.
marta (partnerships): Thanks everyone — I'll post updates here when we have alias confirmation or a resubmitted PO. :v:
